items.title: Colston Loveland was ruled out in Week 12 against the Lions after suffering a knee injury.
items.text: This is concerning. A Lions defender tumbled into Loveland’s lower leg left while the Bears’ tight end was blocking on a run play. After a brief trip to the trainer’s table, he was taken to the locker room for further evaluation. It took only 15 minutes for the team to rule him out. Before exiting, Loveland caught 1-of-1 targets for five yards and lost one fumble. On his lone catch, a Lions defender tied up his legs while a second defender ran in and punched the ball out of his possession. items.title: Colston Loveland was carted to the locker room in Week 12 against the Lions after suffering an apparent leg injury.
items.text: Loveland was tangled up, blocking against a Lions defender when another Lions defender tumbled into Loveland’s lower left leg in a classic roll-up mechanism. Both his ankle and knee could have been injured. Before getting onto the cart, Loveland sat on the trainer’s table with a towel over his head and appeared to be in considerable pain. We expect an update soon. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Speaking with the Pittsburgh-Gazette’s Gerry Dulac, Steelers president Art Rooney II said Aaron Rodgers was not a “good teammate” following his release.
items.text: In a story published by Dulac on Thursday, Rooney said the Steelers are “100 percent” committed to head coach Mike McCarthy, while adding that “insubordination will not be tolerated” as far as Rodgers is concerned. According to Dulac, Rodgers and McCarthy met on Tuesday night, just hours before the QB’s benching, and presented McCarthy with an ultimatum: “let me call the plays or just release me.” What followed from there was Rodgers’ benching and eventual release after he went scorched earth on the Steelers and McCarthy on the Pat McAfee Show on Wednesday. items.title: Speaking on NFL GameDay Morning, NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport said Brock Purdy is considered day-to-day with his ankle injury.
items.text: Purdy suffered a sprained ankle in the Niners’ Week 11 win over the Vikings and was a DNP on Wednesday. Rapoport reports the injury is thought to be “minor,” but noted that whether or not Purdy suits up for Week 12 against the Seahawks “remains to be seen.” Given the importance of the divisional matchup, it’s hard to imagine Purdy sitting at this point. We’ll see how his next two practices go to close out the week, but this doesn’t sound like something we need to be too concerned about just yet. - Zachary Krueger
